mechanism.service: Provide a defined risk-transfer service to a counterparty that values certainty.
mechanism.risk: Tail and inventory risk borne by the strategy.
mechanism.persistence_friction: Capital and risk appetite constrain complete arbitrage.
mechanism.bilateral_rationale: The counterparty rationally pays to transfer risk; the strategy accepts risk for compensation.
mechanism.competition_barrier: The premium is limited by risk-bearing capacity rather than secrecy.

accessibility.capture_path: Public market data and public execution API; no private order flow or colocation.
accessibility.hurdle_rationale: Minimum net effect required after modeled costs and risk/capital charge.
accessibility.cost_model: Fees, spread, slippage and carry estimated from pre-outcome data.
accessibility.cost_uncertainty: Conservative upper cost bound frozen before outcomes.

source_gate.enumerability_rule: All qualifying observations are enumerated from the frozen primary-source rule.
source_gate.timestamp_rule: Signal timestamp must be provably available before the outcome boundary.
source_gate.treatment_binding: Treatment is defined without price/outcome-derived inclusion.

power_gate.dependence_unit: Frozen cluster unit appropriate to the mechanism.

multiplicity.policy: One primary claim; family alpha frozen ex ante; all variants logged.

freeze.outcome_boundary: No outcome data at or after the frozen signal boundary may be opened before commit.
